# Digitális Ugrás

> Digitális Ugrás builds websites, ad packages and monthly content for Hungarian small businesses (nail salons, bakeries, barbershops, shops) in about a week. AI speeds up production; a human reviews and approves every result. Based in Budapest. Site languages: Hungarian (default) and English.

## Services

- Launch package: booking-ready website plus launch-ready ad package, one-time 89,000 Ft for the first 50 clients (regular 149,000 Ft). Usually ready in 5-7 working days.
- Monthly plans, cancel anytime, no long-term contract: Basic 54,000 Ft/month, Standard 79,000 Ft/month, Pro 89,000 Ft/month. The monthly fee covers ad management only; the ad budget (Meta, Google, TikTok) is paid separately to the platform.
